section_summary.extract_value: This section details the statistical analyses performed, including principal-axis exploratory factor analysis (EFA) for the Indonesian BAS, parallel analysis for factor retention, a 3x2 ANOVA examining ethnicity (Javanese, Sundanese, Chinese) and gender (women, men) differences in factor scores, and bivariate correlations between factor scores and participant BMI.
